_doc: Retrieval probes for the adam_film_grammar knowledge base (plan/2026-11-04b Phase 2 exit: 'search_kb finds the right device for 10 probe questions'). A probe passes at k if any of its top-k hits is under one 'expect' source. Written the way a director asks, not in the devices' own words. tests/adam/test_knowledge.py runs them offline with a small keyword ranker (a PROXY for the database's full-text half); the real check is the same queries through match_chunks after `hiru-ai ingest adam_film_grammar` (the hosted dev database: ask first).

probes.query: How do I show a woman pretending to be fine when she is really hurt?
Which camera angle makes a father look commanding?
How can the audience feel what a character is about to lose before the bad news arrives?
How do I set up a small object so it means something at the end of the scene?
What should the camera show after a character walks out of the room?
How do I put the viewer inside a character's head when a shock lands?
Do I have to keep the camera on whoever is speaking, or can I stay on the one listening?
How can sound join two scenes so the next one starts before we see it?
How do I move the sharp focus from one face to another without cutting?
What does Veo get wrong with phone screens and readable names?
